strands.name: Strand A: Scientific Investigation Skills and Career Exploration

overalls.title: Scientific Investigation Skills
overalls.description: demonstrate scientific investigation skills (related to both inquiry and research) in the four areas of skills (initiating and planning, performing and recording, analysing and interpreting, and communicating)

specifics.description: I can ask scientific questions, make predictions, and plan safe investigations.
I can conduct experiments, collect accurate data, and organize it effectively.
I can analyse and interpret data, identify sources of error, and draw evidence-based conclusions.
I can communicate my findings using scientific language, appropriate formats, and precise measurements.

overalls.title: Career Exploration
overalls.description: identify and describe a variety of careers related to the fields of science under study, and identify scientists, including Canadians, who have made contributions to those fields

specifics.description: I can identify practical science-related careers and technical pathways.

strands.name: Strand B: Biology — Tissues, Organs, and Systems

overalls.title: Relating Science to Technology, Society, and the Environment
overalls.description: evaluate the importance of medical technologies in diagnosis and treatment

specifics.description: I can evaluate practical applications of medical imaging and diagnostic tools.

overalls.title: Developing Skills of Investigation and Communication
overalls.description: investigate cell structure and plant/animal organ systems

specifics.description: I can examine plant/animal cells under microscopes and investigate human organ systems.

overalls.title: Understanding Basic Concepts
overalls.description: demonstrate an understanding of cells, tissues, organs, and systems

specifics.description: I can explain cell division and the function of digestive, circulatory, and respiratory systems.

strands.name: Strand C: Chemistry — Chemical Reactions and their Applications

overalls.title: Relating Science to Technology, Society, and the Environment
overalls.description: analyse practical applications of chemical reactions

specifics.description: I can analyze common chemical products, household safety, and disposal procedures.

overalls.title: Developing Skills of Investigation and Communication
overalls.description: investigate chemical reactions and acid-base indicators

specifics.description: I can conduct tests to classify chemical reactions and measure acidity/alkalinity using pH indicators.

overalls.title: Understanding Basic Concepts
overalls.description: demonstrate an understanding of simple chemical compounds and equations

specifics.description: I can name simple chemical compounds, write word equations, and state the law of conservation of mass.

strands.name: Strand D: Earth and Space Science — Earth's Dynamic Climate

overalls.title: Relating Science to Technology, Society, and the Environment
overalls.description: assess impacts of climate change on local environments

specifics.description: I can evaluate local impacts of weather events and climate change.

overalls.title: Developing Skills of Investigation and Communication
overalls.description: investigate weather patterns and climate indicators

specifics.description: I can gather and analyze local weather data and climate trends.

overalls.title: Understanding Basic Concepts
overalls.description: demonstrate an understanding of heat transfer and climate factors

specifics.description: I can explain heat transfer, atmospheric moisture, and human actions affecting climate.

strands.name: Strand E: Physics — Light and Applications of Optics

overalls.title: Relating Science to Technology, Society, and the Environment
overalls.description: evaluate everyday applications of optical technologies

specifics.description: I can describe practical optical devices used in daily life (eyeglasses, magnifying glasses, flashlights).

overalls.title: Developing Skills of Investigation and Communication
overalls.description: investigate properties of light and reflection

specifics.description: I can investigate reflection, refraction, and image formation with mirrors and lenses.

overalls.title: Understanding Basic Concepts
overalls.description: demonstrate an understanding of light behaviour and optics

specifics.description: I can describe light sources, color production, reflection laws, and refraction concepts.
